objective: Collect Spot vibe reports during timed board check-in, aggregate deduplicated reports into each Spot's top two vibes, and show amenities on Spot cards and the compact Spot top section.
userOutcome: Members report the current Spot vibe when entering its board, then see the two most-reported vibes and known amenities before interacting with the Spot.
successCriteria: The board check-in control includes dedicated Spot vibe choices and requires at least one selection in the current client.
A check-in accepts up to three Spot vibes and replaces that member's prior report set for the same Spot.
Each member contributes at most one count per selected vibe per Spot, regardless of repeated check-ins.
Spot responses expose the two vibes with the most unique member reports, with stored suggestion vibes as the no-report fallback.
The compact top section, Spot list cards, and Spot detail show at most two top vibes.
Stored amenities appear on Spot list cards and in the compact top section.
Who’s Here remains visible without a check-in; only Board posts require an active check-in.
mustPreserve: Preserve the dedicated Spot vibe taxonomy and never reuse profile vibes.
Preserve board access duration, geolocation checks, Who's Here choice, permanent board posts, deletion, encryption, moderation, and expiry notifications.
Preserve board-first layout, map behavior, Spot filters, amenities, and unrelated user work.
Preserve older clients by accepting check-ins without vibe reports while the current interface requires them.
nonGoals: No demographic aggregation, Crowd fit, profile-vibe changes, fabricated reports, or fabricated amenities.
No tests, build, preview, migration execution, push, or deployment.

assumptions.statement: A member may report one to three Spot vibes at check-in, matching the existing Spot suggestion limit.
assumptions.impact: Reports capture a small set while the visible aggregate remains limited to the top two.

assumptions.statement: Aggregate means unique-member counts over retained check-in reports, with the most recently reported vibe breaking equal-count ties.
assumptions.impact: Repeated check-ins cannot inflate counts and equal results respond to newer reports.

nextVisibleMilestone: Commit the check-in vibe-report aggregation and expanded amenity display as intentionally unverified source.
stopConditions: Stop before tests, build, preview, migration execution, push, deployment, or inferred data.
